provenance: Authored independently from metric definitions before execution and without production source, authentic data, numerical libraries, or model outputs.

contract.auc: Mean credit over every positive-negative pair: 1 for positive score greater, 0.5 for equal, otherwise 0.
contract.balanced_accuracy: Arithmetic mean of TP/(TP+FN) and TN/(TN+FP).
contract.invalid: ValueError for empty/mismatched inputs, absent classes, nonbinary or non-builtin-integer labels, bools, non-builtin-numeric probabilities, nonfinite probabilities, or probabilities outside [0,1].

valid.name: perfect
valid.derivation: Each of two positives beats both negatives: credit 4/4. Both sensitivities are 1.

valid.name: reverse
valid.derivation: Neither positive beats or ties either negative: credit 0/4. All four threshold decisions are wrong.

valid.name: all_ties_below_threshold
valid.derivation: Four ties earn 4*0.5/4 = 0.5. Sensitivity 0 and specificity 1 average to 0.5.

valid.name: all_ties_at_threshold
valid.derivation: Four ties earn 0.5 AUC. Equality is positive: sensitivity 1 and specificity 0 average to 0.5.

valid.name: partial_ties
valid.derivation: Positive 0.2 earns 1+0.5; positive 0.6 earns 1+1, total 3.5/4 = 7/8. BA = (2/2 + 1/2)/2 = 3/4.

valid.name: threshold_exact_and_immediately_below
valid.derivation: The higher positive earns 1+0.5; lower positive earns 0.5+0, total 2/4. Each class has one correct decision of two.

valid.name: imbalanced_two_positive_four_negative
valid.derivation: Positive 0.9 wins all four pairs. Positive 0.1 loses twice, ties once, wins once: total 5.5/8 = 11/16. BA = (1/2 + 3/4)/2 = 5/8, distinct from ordinary accuracy 4/6.

valid.name: probability_endpoints
valid.derivation: The sole positive-negative comparison is a win. Closed interval endpoints are valid and classified correctly.

invalid.name: missing_positive_class
invalid.derivation: No positive denominator exists for either metric.

invalid.name: missing_negative_class
invalid.derivation: No negative denominator exists for either metric.
